description: A QUnit test script for the Leave Control Panel feature in an HR module, testing leave allocation functionality and verifying data update across the system.

methods.name: QUnit.module
methods.description: Defines a test module for grouping related tests.

methods.name: QUnit.test
methods.description: Defines an individual test case, in this case testing leave control panel functionality.

methods.name: assert.expect
methods.description: Defines the number of assertions expected in the test.

methods.name: assert.async
methods.description: Handles asynchronous testing by providing a 'done' callback.

methods.name: frappe.run_serially
methods.description: Runs a sequence of functions in order, used here to execute the test steps.

methods.name: frappe.set_route
methods.description: Navigates to a specific form or list within the application.

methods.name: cur_frm.set_value
methods.description: Sets a value for a field in the current form.

methods.name: frappe.timeout
methods.description: Introduces a delay, used for waiting for UI updates.

methods.name: frappe.click_button
methods.description: Simulates clicking a button in the UI.

methods.name: frappe.call
methods.description: Performs an API call to the server-side method.
